descriptions.preferred: 三日月 由美国巴克霍兹苗圃的苗圃主泰隆 ·巴克霍兹选育并 推广， 是经典的脉叶品种。 三日月发芽较早，叶裂长且窄，春天叶色为明亮的 红粉色 ，并有紫红色的脉纹，非常吸睛 。 夏天变为奶绿色，并有绿色的脉纹，秋天为金黄色 。 三日月的 三季 色彩 都非常亮眼，生长速度中等，午后需要 适当 遮阴，成年株 高 可达 3米左右。

rhs.description: Upright, bushy, deciduous shrubby tree about 3m tall, with deeply divided narrow leaves composed of long narrow lobes, emerging bright pink with green veins in spring, then pale green in summer with darker veins, followed by bright orange with green veins in autumn. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, purple-red flowers in spring are followed by red-flushed, winged fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 三日月 由美国巴克霍兹苗圃的苗圃主泰隆 ·巴克霍兹选育并 推广， 是经典的脉叶品种。 三日月发芽较早，叶裂长且窄，春天叶色为明亮的 红粉色 ，并有紫红色的脉纹，非常吸睛 。 夏天变为奶绿色，并有绿色的脉纹，秋天为金黄色 。 三日月的 三季 色彩 都非常亮眼，生长速度中等，午后需要 适当 遮阴，成年株 高 可达 3米左右。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度易导致叶缘焦枯。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱天气时需特别注意浇水。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 直立、丛生的落叶灌木状小乔木，高约 3 米。 叶片深裂，由细长裂片组成，春季初展时呈鲜粉色并带绿色叶脉，夏季转为淡绿色、叶脉较深，秋季则变为鲜橙色并保留绿色叶脉。 春季开不显眼的小型紫红色花，下垂成簇，之后结带红晕的翅果。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Mikazuki' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Mikazuki' Reticulated Variegated Crescent Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Mikazuki’ leafs out in the early spring with a bright pink-red leaf accented by deep reddish-purple veining that gives a great contrast to the leaf, making this Japanese maple tree extremely appealing. Each leaf is heavily divided, more so than any of the other reticulated veined types in this category of Japanese maples. This is where this tree gets its name which translates as “crescent moon”. By mid-summer, ‘Mikazuki’ will turn to greenish-cream accented by deep-green veining. Autumn colors of this Japanese maple are bright golden yellows to oranges. ‘Mikazuki’ will reach 10 ft tall by 7 ft wide in 15 years making it a great mid-sized tree for the garden. In the South, protection from the hot afternoon sun will increase the length of its spring display of pink-red on this Japanese maple.
